# Project steering meeting, Tuesday 14 October 2025

**Attendees:** Priya Nair (chair), Tom Becker, Aisha Rahman, Luis Ortega. Apologies: Chen Wei.

## 1. Data reload

Tom reported that the sensor data reload is not finished. A change in the timestamp format (the files moved from local time to UTC) overstated the temperature readings by about 0.4 degrees in the first draft of the dashboard. The dashboard cannot be republished until the reload is done. Priya noted that this is tight, because the results section depends on the republished dashboard.

Decision: the dashboard will be republished once the reload is complete, and a correction note will go to users on the same day.

## 2. Ethics check

Aisha said the ethics check on the interview protocol has not been completed. Dr Malik has not replied to the last two emails. Luis suggested phoning the ethics office instead of waiting for a reply. No one disagreed.

## 3. Budget

About 4,200 dollars remain in the project budget. The field trip deposit of 1,500 dollars is due on 24 October. The group agreed not to book the second field trip until the budget is confirmed.

## 4. Open questions

Who will write the results section if the reload slips past the end of October? Can the draft report go out without the interview findings, or must they be included?

## Actions

- Tom Becker to finish the data reload and tell the group by Friday 24 October.
- Aisha Rahman to chase Dr Malik about the ethics check by Wednesday 15 October.
- Luis Ortega to phone the ethics office on Thursday 16 October.
- Priya Nair to send the correction note to dashboard users on the day the dashboard is republished.
